normative_extracts.quote: A transaction created using transaction() is active immediately upon creation, and auto-commits as soon as the event loop finishes executing requests and no new requests are placed against it.

browser_support.notes: StorageManager.estimate() is Baseline Widely Available across all modern engines.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: IndexedDB serializes overlapping readwrite transactions per object store and auto-commits any transaction left idle across an async await boundary.

production_failures.symptom: TransactionInactiveError thrown right after await fetch() inside an IDB transaction
production_failures.root_cause: Awaiting a network or macrotask promise yields control of the event loop, causing the IDB transaction to auto-commit before the next store.put() runs.
production_failures.mitigation: Complete all fetch/async work before opening db.transaction(), or wrap only synchronous/IDB-request chains inside the transaction.

production_failures.symptom: QuotaExceededError on Safari Private Browsing or low-disk devices
production_failures.root_cause: Origin storage quota is dynamic (percentage of free disk) and Best-Effort storage can be evicted under disk pressure.
production_failures.mitigation: Check navigator.storage.estimate(), request navigator.storage.persist(), and handle QuotaExceededError with LRU pruning.
